items.title: 6 things investors need to watch in the week ahead
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host, Josh Lipton, tees up the key events investors should watch in the week ahead, starting Monday, August 31, with earnings from Dell (DELL), Palo Alto Networks (PANW), Lululemon (LULU), and Snowflake. (SNOW) On Wednesday, Broadcom's (AVGO) results will offer another read on the AI trade. Then on Friday, investors will get the August jobs report, with economists expecting the unemployment rate to hold steady at 4.1%

Organizations can apply automated retention policies to AI interaction records to support oversight and compliance needs.
